root.label: Ukraine denies F-16 maintenance and parts crisis

events.label: Ukraine denies F-16 maintenance and parts crisis

slots.name: maintenance status
slots.sentence: Ukraine denies that it is facing maintenance and supply problems with its F-16 fighter jets, insisting it can keep them in the air throughout winter.

slots.name: aircraft availability rate
slots.sentence: The Wall Street Journal reported this week that delays in maintenance and a shortage of parts had grounded more than half of Ukraine’s fleet, and all of its US-made aircraft could be affected by the year-end.
